subject: Insurance
title: Voice Stress Analysis
description: A micro-lesson that makes Voice Stress Analysis usable.

hook.text: Some insurers use voice stress analysis during phone claims.

buildup.text: When people lie, subtle vocal changes occur: pitch shifts, speech hesitation, and stress patterns.

discovery.text: UK insurers like Admiral have used voice analysis on claims calls.

twist.text: The scientific evidence for voice stress detection is weak. Critics say it's no better than a coin flip.

climax.text: Voice analysis is a deterrent as much as a detection tool.

punchline.text: Your voice trembles when you lie.

quiz.question: What's the main criticism of voice stress analysis in insurance?
options: Scientific evidence for its accuracy is weak
